noPremises: A starting premise: it rests on nothing else in the chain.
noConsequences: A final conclusion: nothing follows from it.
hint: Drag or scroll to move the graph; Ctrl + scroll or + and − zoom. ← → go in order, ↑ to a premise, ↓ to a consequence, 0 shows the whole graph.
graphLabel: Thesis graph: arrows lead from premises to conclusions
